yaml.default:
# M5 上下文工程：顯式寫出 compaction / pruner / spill 設定（contextProfile=default）。
# 數值與理由見 docs/upgrade/context-tuning.md；patch 會整段取代 bundle 預設 config。
- id: compaction-basic
  config:
    auto: true
    thresholdRatio: 0.8
    headroomTokens: 65536
    retainRatio: 0.16
    maxTokens: 65536
    summarizationProvider: ""
    summarizationModel: ""
    compactionRetries: 1
    maxOverflowRetries: 1
    modelPolicies: []
- id: tool-result-pruner
  config:
    thresholdChars: 8192
    headChars: 4096
    tailChars: 1024
- id: spill-policy
  config:
    maxInlineTokens: 12500
- id: spill-local
  config:
    cleanupPeriodDays: 30
